'''Jones''': {{legend0|#a5b0ff|40–50%}} | title = [[List of governors of Nevada|Governor]] | before_election = [[Bob Miller (Nevada politician)|Bob Miller]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Kenny Guinn]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsNV}} The '''1998 Nevada gubernatorial election''' was held on November 3, 1998 to elect the [[List of governors of Nevada|governor of Nevada]]. Democratic incumbent [[Bob Miller (Nevada politician)|Bob Miller]] was [[Term limits in the United States|term limited]] and constitutionally ineligible to seek a fourth consecutive term in office. Republican businessman [[Kenny Guinn]] defeated [[List of mayors of Las Vegas|Las Vegas mayor]] [[Jan Laverty Jones]]. This was the first open Nevada gubernatorial election since [[1978 Nevada gubernatorial election|1978]] and also the first time since 1978 that a Republican was elected governor of Nevada. As of 2026, this is also the most recent gubernatorial election in which the Democratic nominee carried any county other than [[Clark County, Nevada|Clark]] and [[Washoe County, Nevada|Washoe]]. ==Democratic primary== ===Candidates=== *Caeser D.
